name: Lab: 24-2 (30 points), eye tracker, 57 cm
description: For the 17 Nov meeting. BenQ 24.5" (542.3 x 305 mm), chin rest so the eye is 57 cm from the screen, where the Tobii Pro Fusion tracks well. 24-2 positions with only the rows 3 and 9 deg above and below the + (out to 21 deg across): 32 points, the 2 in the blind spot left out -> 30, 6 deg apart, + in the centre. The 15 deg rows do not fit on this screen beyond 53.2 cm. Full Threshold 4-2 staircase (OPI). Fixation check, blinks and monocular calibration as in the 5 deg grid preset (our suggestion, to tune). The eye-tracker bridge starts and closes with the app (Start ReFreM, or python\specvis.bat app). Choose the ColorCAL scale "Lab screen". No dithering: the faintest patch is one grey step and the seeds start in the middle of the range, both from the photometer (Lab screen: 0.1 to 32.9 dB, start 16.5 dB).
